description: Rewrite a resume for ATS screening, for one posting or in general. The base resume does not change. Uses AI credits. resume_text is optional: the user can paste or attach a resume in the chat, and you pass its text as resume_text. Without it, the tool uses the resume already on the user's account. In ChatGPT the user can attach a resume file; pass it as resume_file.

job_description.description: Full text of the target job description (optional, omit for general ATS optimization)

resume_file.description: Only for a resume file the user attached in ChatGPT: pass the attached file here, not retyped text. In any other client pass resume_text or resume_url. It is downloaded once, right away: PDF, DOCX or plain text, up to 10 MB.

resume_text.description: Full text of the resume to optimize. The resume the user pasted or attached in this conversation, as plain text. Omit it to use the resume already on the user's GetMattered account.

name: getmattered_optimize_resume

setupStep.description: Set while account setup is open: the step to take first.

title: Optimize Resume
